messages:
Alex (Sales): Kicking off thread for ACME POC — they want p99 < 250ms for chat, and ~200 tpm sustained during business hours. They asked about reserved GPUs and autoscale. @Jordan can you confirm GPU counts and pricing?

Jordan (Sales Eng): Quick calc: our benchmark for redwood-medium (8k ctx) shows ~600 rps on 2xA10-equivalent for short prompts. For 200 tpm that's ~3.3 rps so very small, but peak concurrency and KV cache change the math. Need session distribution + avg tokens per request.

Nina (SRE): For 200 tpm sustained with a 250ms p99 target, 1xA100-40GB Dedicated + autoscale (min=1 max=3) should be safe assuming avg 300 tokens per minute per session. Recommend min_reserved=1, burst credits enabled, and concurrency cap=8 per GPU.

Jordan (Sales Eng): Config sketch:
```
autoscale:
  min_replicas: 1
  max_replicas: 3
  scale_policy: latency_based
  burst_credits: 2h
  concurrency_per_gpu: 8
```

Alex (Sales): Procurement asked for monthly pricing: reserved A100-40GB vs on-demand. Any ballpark + discount for 12mo?

Eli (Finance): Ballpark: reserved A100-40GB ~ $18,000/mo list, on-demand ~ $25,000/mo. 12mo commit ~20% off -> ~$14,400/mo. I'll push final numbers to sales ops.

Maria (Prod): Security/POC note: ACME requires VPC peering + no internet egress for workloads. Can we do Dedicated in their VPC for the POC? Also they want KMS + SOC2 docs.

Jordan (Sales Eng): Dedicated in-customer VPC is supported but 2–3 week lead time for provisioning. Hosted with private data retention is faster but may not satisfy no-egress. We can propose Hosted POC first, then Dedicated if they sign commit.

Alex (Sales): POC plan proposal: start hosted trial with strict retention and auditing + spin up Dedicated (1xA100) if they approve commit. Also confirm: can we set min_replicas=0 to control cost?

Nina (SRE): Dedicated tier does not support min=0 currently; min=1. Hosted can scale to zero. For cost control, use burst credits and short max_replicas.

Jordan (Sales Eng): I'll assemble a perf runbook and load script. Sample quick test:
```
for i in $(seq 1 1000); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"prompt":"test"}' &
done
```

Alex (Sales): Action items: Jordan -> perf report + load script by Wed; Eli -> preliminary cost quote; Maria -> SOC2 + VPC checklist. I'll sync with ACME Mon morning. Anyone else?

deploy-bot: autoscale policy applied to poc-cluster: min=1 max=3 burst_credit=2h (nina)

Jordan (Sales Eng): Ack — will attach runbook + proposed commit tiers (1mo trial, 12mo reserved options).

Nina (SRE): :thumbsup:

Alex (Sales): Thanks all — looping in @Eli for finance notes.
